label: Natural photo
description: Best all-round for camera photos. Real-looking hair, skin, fabric and foliage. Also cleans light JPEG artifacts.

label: Soft or compressed
description: For blurry, heavily compressed or noisy images: phone shots, web downloads, old scans. Smoother result.

label: Quick preview
description: About 20× faster. Fine for checking a crop or for big batches; use Natural photo for the final print.
